US Envoy Walks Out During Iranian President's UN Speech

During an address at the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), Iran's President Ebrahim Raisi displayed photographs of victims from Minab. In response, the US envoy present at the assembly walked out. Some reports also mention former Iranian prisoners speaking out as anti-regime protests occurred at the UN.
